title: Step 2a - Implementing Hierarchical Clustering: Building a Dendrogram with SciPy

cues.en: Instructor: All right, my friends, are you ready?
cues.zh: 講師：好，朋友們，準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Are you ready to build that dendrogram and use it to find the optimal number of clusters?
cues.zh: 準備好建立樹狀圖，用它找出最佳群組數量了嗎？

cues.en: Here we go, let's implement the solution together.
cues.zh: 來吧，一起實作解法。

cues.en: So, let's start by creating a new code cell And now what will be the first step?
cues.zh: 先建立新的程式碼儲存格，第一步是什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, as usual, you know, we want to implement this efficiently.
cues.zh: 照慣例，我們希望有效率地實作。

cues.en: So, we're gonna use a function, but this time, exceptionally, this function won't be imported from scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 所以要使用函式，但這次例外，不會從 scikit-learn 匯入。

cues.en: It will actually be imported from another very popular library in data science.
cues.zh: 而是從另一個在資料科學中非常受歡迎的函式庫匯入。

cues.en: I would say, you know, it is in the top three most popular libraries.
cues.zh: 我會說，它是最受歡迎的前三大函式庫之一。

cues.en: I put scikit-learn first, of course, and tenor flow for deep learning.
cues.zh: 當然，scikit-learn 排第一，深度學習則是 TensorFlow。

cues.en: But that other library is SciPy.
cues.zh: 另一個函式庫就是 SciPy。

cues.en: SciPy contains a lot of great tools when building machinery models and, well, for hierarchical clustering it, indeed, contains a function, which is called dendrogram,
cues.zh: SciPy 包含很多建立機器學習模型的好工具；對階層式分群來說，它確實有個叫 dendrogram 的函式，

cues.en: and which will return the dendrogram itself.
cues.zh: 會傳回樹狀圖本身。

cues.en: You know, the plot of the dendrogram.
cues.zh: 也就是樹狀圖的圖形。

cues.en: So, let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's directly import that, you know, module first that contains this function.
cues.zh: 先直接匯入包含這個函式的模組。

cues.en: And as we said, this model is taken first from SciPy.
cues.zh: 剛才說過，這個模組首先來自 scipy，

cues.en: Then from the module cluster.
cues.zh: 接著是 cluster 模組，

cues.en: And then from the submodule hierarchy, right?
cues.zh: 再來是 hierarchy 子模組，對吧？

cues.en: Google Colab guesses it perfectly.
cues.zh: Google Colab 猜得非常準。

cues.en: The other way to write this is, of course, to say from SciPy import cluster.hierarchy.
cues.zh: 另一種寫法，當然是用 from scipy import 的形式，匯入 cluster.hierarchy。

cues.en: So, that's just another writing.
cues.zh: 這只是另一種寫法。

cues.en: And then we're gonna add, of course, a shortcut to this.
cues.zh: 接著當然加上一個簡稱。

cues.en: Otherwise, we would need to call all of this again.
cues.zh: 否則每次都得呼叫這一長串。

cues.en: And the shortcut will be as SCH, right?
cues.zh: 簡稱寫成 as sch，對吧？

cues.en: For SciPy cluster hierarchy.
cues.zh: 代表 SciPy、cluster、hierarchy。

cues.en: Okay, so, that's the module which contains the function we want to use in order to build our dendrogram.
cues.zh: 好，這就是包含我們要用來建立樹狀圖之函式的模組。

cues.en: So, now, next step.
cues.zh: 接著下一步。

cues.en: Well, the next step is to use that function which we can now access from that hierarchy module, which we just imported.
cues.zh: 下一步就是使用這個函式，現在可以透過剛匯入的 hierarchy 模組存取它。

cues.en: And since this function returns directly the dendrogram itself, well, we are gonna create a new variable here which we're gonna call dendrogram.
cues.zh: 由於這個函式會直接傳回樹狀圖，我們就在這裡建立新變數，命名為 dendrogram。

cues.en: As simple as that.
cues.zh: 就是這麼簡單。

cues.en: And this dendrogram variable will be the output of this dendrogram function, which we're about to use from the hierarchy submodule by the cluster module
cues.zh: dendrogram 變數會是 dendrogram 函式的輸出，接下來透過 hierarchy 子模組使用它；它隸屬 cluster 模組，

cues.en: from the SciPy library.
cues.zh: 來自 SciPy 函式庫。

cues.en: Alright, so, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，來做吧。

cues.en: Since this function belongs to all of this here, you know, the hierarchy module, well, we have to call first the shortcut leading to that module, SCH.
cues.zh: 由於這個函式屬於這裡的 hierarchy 模組，要先呼叫通往這個模組的簡稱 sch。

cues.en: And from which now we can call this dendrogram function.
cues.zh: 現在就能從中呼叫 dendrogram 函式。

cues.en: Perfect, thank you so much, Google Colab.
cues.zh: 很好，非常感謝 Google Colab。

cues.en: And now indeed, in the parenthesis, we have to input some arguments.
cues.zh: 括號裡確實要輸入一些引數。

cues.en: And now you can't really guess what the argument will be, so, I'm just going to write it and then I will explain what this means.
cues.zh: 這個引數你不太可能直接猜出來，所以我先寫，再解釋意思。

cues.en: So, first we actually have to call SCH again, you know, the hierarchy module from the cluster module from the SciPy library.
cues.zh: 首先要再次呼叫 sch，也就是 SciPy 函式庫中 cluster 模組的 hierarchy 模組。

cues.en: So, SCH from which, this time we're gonna call another function, which is the linkage function.
cues.zh: 這次從 sch 呼叫另一個函式，也就是 linkage。

cues.en: And this linkage function will take as input two arguments.
cues.zh: linkage 函式接受兩個引數。

cues.en: First, well, your matrix of features inside which you want to identify the clusters.
cues.zh: 第一個是你想在其中辨識群組的特徵矩陣。

cues.en: And that's, of course, X.
cues.zh: 當然就是 X。

cues.en: And then the second argument is the clustering technique.
cues.zh: 第二個引數是分群方法。

cues.en: And in hierarchical clustering, the most recommended method, and the one that brings the most relevant results and the most relevant clusters,
cues.zh: 在階層式分群中，最推薦、也最能產生有意義結果與群組的方法，

cues.en: is the method of minimum variance, which is a technique that will result in having clusters inside which, you know, the observation points don't vary too much, you know,
cues.zh: 是最小變異數法。這項技術會讓群組內的觀測點變化不會太大，

cues.en: have among all of them a low variance.
cues.zh: 也就是群內各點的變異數較低。

cues.en: And that's what it means, you know?
cues.zh: 就是這個意思。

cues.en: The method of minimum variants consists of minimizing the variants in each of the clusters resulting from hierarchical clustering.
cues.zh: 最小變異數法，會最小化階層式分群產生的每個群組內部的變異數。

cues.en: And so, this is really the method that I recommend.
cues.zh: 這是我非常推薦的方法。

cues.en: And speaking of this method, that's exactly the next argument of this linkage function we have to input here.
cues.zh: 說到這個方法，它正是 linkage 函式下一個要輸入的引數。

cues.en: And the name of that parameter is method.
cues.zh: 參數名稱是 method。

cues.en: And the name of that minimum variance method is not called minimum variance but ward.
cues.zh: 這個最小變異數法的名稱不叫 minimum variance，而叫 ward。

cues.en: Ward, you can actually check this on Wikipedia.
cues.zh: Ward，你可以到維基百科查看。

cues.en: There is a whole page on ward, and you will see that indeed it consists of minimizing the variants inside your clusters.
cues.zh: 有一整頁介紹 Ward，會看到它確實是在最小化群內變異數。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And that's it for the whole dendrogram function here.
cues.zh: 這就是整個 dendrogram 函式的內容。

cues.en: It only expects one argument, which is basically the method you choose for your clustering that you link to your matrix of features, X, in which you want to identify the clusters.
cues.zh: 它只需要一個引數，基本上就是把你選的分群方法，與想要辨識群組的特徵矩陣 X 連結起來的結果。

cues.en: So, that's all you need to input here in this dendrogram.
cues.zh: 這就是 dendrogram 裡需要輸入的全部內容。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: This will already return the dendrogram itself, you know the plot of the dendrogram.
cues.zh: 這樣就會傳回樹狀圖本身，也就是樹狀圖的圖形。

cues.en: But, as usual, we want to make it nice.
cues.zh: 不過照慣例，我們希望圖好看一點。

cues.en: So, we're just gonna add a title, an X label, and a Y label, and then we will show it, and I will teach you how to read the dendrogram to indeed find that optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 所以加上標題、X 軸與 Y 軸標籤，再顯示出來；我會教你如何解讀樹狀圖，找出最佳群組數量。
